notes.title: Manic Magic: Ciena's Desire Upcoming Release!
notes.content: [h3][i]We are aiming to release in four weeks. It took us a little longer to finish all the endings and animations, but we think it will be worth the wait![/i][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][b][u]We're currently doing our final round of play-testing to make sure all the Steam achievements trigger correctly, as there is now a final grand total of 55 achievements in the game.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45521813/374ca68ae0bf6e1374b85b3d6ef989e65bead830.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]We're also putting in some final touches on the text and polishing up the animations.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45521813/a8325c038f2fe288d3a3a4589c13d15b8668722d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]The intro has been rewritten, and the intro in the demo version no longer reflects the intro in the final version, so please re-watch the new intro when the game launches in a few weeks! The new opening introduces a new character previously not in the demo version along with changing the characters' dialogue to be more fitting.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45521813/9890016654e11cd5b71d9d64d0f10af5d2944448.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We will be working hard to make sure everything is nice and ready by launch day.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]To stay up to date and not miss a thing, don’t forget to wishlist the game — you’ll get notified about all release details.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3][i]~ See you very soon![/i][/h3]
